name: get_demo_context
description: Read the simulated day and the current number of planned questions from the open WASL demo. Call this when asked about the demo context. It cannot save or change anything.

name: get_demo_question
description: Read the first planned synthetic check-in question currently shown by WASL. Call this when asked which question WASL has planned. If no question is available, say so. This is informational only and no answer is saved.
